seo.title: Luis Schulz – Professional Triathlete & Coach
seo.description: Luis Schulz races as a professional triathlete from 2027. Personal triathlon coaching, race schedule and partnerships.

heroText: I'm Luis Schulz – a triathlete on the way to professional racing and a coach for athletes who want to reach their full potential.
introText:
Behind every race are thousands of training hours, a well-designed plan and the will to get a little better every day.

From the 2027 season I race as a professional. As a coach, I share what I've learned from training, racing and sports science – structured, honest and individual.

pillars.title: Athlete
pillars.text: My path into professional triathlon – background, goals and season plan.

pillars.title: Coaching
pillars.text: Individual training plans and support, from your first triathlon to the full distance.

pillars.title: Partners
pillars.text: Growing together: partnerships with brands that share performance and values.

quote: The goal isn't to be faster than others – it's to be faster than yesterday.
ctaText: Coaching, partnership or press – I look forward to hearing from you.
